Consequently, current detection methods face major obstacles when dealing with emergent fake news events, where accumulating large, well-annotated datasets is impractical. The model combines meta-learning techniques with neural process methodologies to maximize performance. Key innovations include a proposed label embedding module for processing categorical nuances and a hard attention mechanism to filter out irrelevant content to enhance detection efficacy. Rigorous testing on multimedia datasets sourced from Twitter and Weibo demonstrates that MetaFEND effectively identifies misinformation on unseen events and surpasses existing state-of-the-art methods.
